agency.zh: 蒙大拿州公共卫生与公众服务部食品与消费者安全科

how.en: Fill in the license application and give it with the fee to the local county sanitarian, who inspects the establishment and sends the application to DPHHS; DPHHS doesn't take applications directly from businesses.
how.zh: 填写执照申请表，连同费用交给所在县的卫生检查员；检查员检查经营场所后将申请转交州公共卫生与公众服务部。该部门不直接受理企业的申请。

feeNote.en: $85 with 2 or fewer employees working at any one time, $115 with more, as printed on the application.
feeNote.zh: 同一时间在岗员工不超过 2 人的为 85 美元，超过 2 人的为 115 美元，按申请表所列。

label.zh: 持照人（业主或经营者）法定名称

label.en: Establishment address, city, ZIP and county
label.zh: 经营场所地址、城市、邮编及县

label.en: Foods handled and how (stored, processed, packaged, sold)
label.zh: 经营的食品及方式（储存、加工、包装、销售）
所有者、合伙人或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: Montana's license for a restaurant or store that sells food to the public.
plain.zh: 蒙大拿州为向公众销售食品的餐厅或商店颁发的执照。

proof.quote: you will likely need a retail food license, which may be obtained through your local sanitarian.

form: Sales/Use Tax License Application (Rev 5/04/2023)

title.en: Wyoming sales and use tax license
title.zh: 怀俄明州销售税和使用税执照

agency.en: Wyoming Department of Revenue, Excise Tax Division
agency.zh: 怀俄明州税务局消费税处

how.en: Open a WYIFS account online, then apply for the license on the same site (about two weeks in all), or mail the paper application with the $60 fee to the Department of Revenue in Cheyenne. Every owner signs: originals on paper.
how.zh: 先在线开立 WYIFS 账户，再在同一网站申请执照（共约两周）；或将纸质申请表连同 60 美元费用邮寄至夏延市的州税务局。所有业主均须签字，纸质申请须亲笔原签。

feeNote.en: $60, non-refundable.
feeNote.zh: 60 美元，不予退还。

takes.en: About two weeks online; longer by mail.
takes.zh: 在线约两周；邮寄需更久。

label.en: Date of first sale in the state (MM/DD/YYYY)
label.zh: 在该州首次销售的日期（月/日/年）
销售的产品及 NAICS 代码
所有者、成员或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: Wyoming's license to collect sales tax on goods sold there.
plain.zh: 怀俄明州允许企业就当地销售的商品代收销售税的执照。

proof.quote: If you are selling tangible personal property, the answer is yes.
proof.en: Asked whether a storefront needs a Wyoming sales tax license, the department answers that a seller of tangible personal property does.

form: Joint business registration with DWS on WYUI (unemployment insurance and workers' compensation)

title.en: Wyoming employer registration (unemployment insurance and workers' compensation)
title.zh: 怀俄明州雇主登记（失业保险和工伤保险）

agency.en: Wyoming Department of Workforce Services
agency.zh: 怀俄明州劳动力服务厅

how.en: Register on WYUI under Employer Services, Register New Business with DWS. DWS uses it to open the unemployment insurance account and decide the state workers' compensation coverage, which employers subject to the Act must have before work starts. Wyoming has no state income tax to withhold.
how.zh: 在 WYUI 的 Employer Services 中选择 Register New Business with DWS 进行登记。劳动力服务厅据此开立失业保险账户并确定州工伤保险的投保要求；受该法约束的雇主须在开工前取得承保。怀俄明州没有须预扣的州所得税。

feeNote.en: The agency's page doesn't state a fee; it confirms any fee when it takes the filing.
feeNote.zh: 该机构页面未注明费用；如有费用，受理时由其确认。

label.en: Date wages were first paid in the state (MM/DD/YYYY)
label.zh: 在该州首次支付工资的日期（月/日/年）
所有者或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: The one Wyoming registration that sets up an employer's unemployment insurance and state workers' comp.
plain.zh: 怀俄明州为雇主同时办理失业保险和州工伤保险的统一登记。

proof.quote: Even if a business may be non-liable or optional under Wyoming’s Workers’ Compensation fund, registration is still required so DWS can make that determination.

form: Food establishment or processing plant license (Consumer Health Services)

title.zh: 怀俄明州食品执照

agency.en: Wyoming Department of Agriculture, Consumer Health Services
agency.zh: 怀俄明州农业厅消费者健康服务处

how.en: The application isn't online: the local Consumer Health Services inspector (or, in a city or county with its own program, the local health department) provides it and inspects before the license is issued.
how.zh: 申请表不在网上提供：由当地消费者健康服务处检查员（或在设有自身项目的市县，由当地卫生部门）提供，并在发照前进行检查。

feeNote.en: $200 for a new establishment, new owner or new location, then $100 a year.
feeNote.zh: 新开业、业主变更或迁址的首次费用为 200 美元，之后每年 100 美元。

label.zh: 持照人（业主或经营者）法定名称

label.en: Establishment address, city, ZIP and county
label.zh: 经营场所地址、城市、邮编及县

label.en: Foods handled and how (stored, processed, packaged, sold)
label.zh: 经营的食品及方式（储存、加工、包装、销售）
所有者、合伙人或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: Wyoming's license for any place that makes, stores, sells or serves food.
plain.zh: 怀俄明州为生产、储存、销售或供应食品的场所颁发的执照。

proof.quote: No establishment or processing plant shall serve, hold for sale or sell food to the public without a valid license.

form: Business License: NEW Application (Form 08-4181)

title.zh: 阿拉斯加州营业执照

agency.en: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing
agency.zh: 阿拉斯加州公司、商业与专业执照处

how.en: Apply online, or mail Form 08-4181 with the fee to Business Licensing, PO Box 110806, Juneau (up to 3 weeks; no email). A company must be in good standing with the Corporations Section first. Alaska has no state sales tax; some boroughs and cities levy their own.
how.zh: 在线申请，或将 08-4181 表连同费用邮寄至 Business Licensing（PO Box 110806, Juneau），最长约 3 周，不接受电子邮件。公司须先在公司科处于良好存续状态。阿拉斯加州不征收州销售税，部分自治市镇和城市自行征收。

feeNote.en: $50 for one year or $100 for two years.
feeNote.zh: 一年 50 美元，两年 100 美元。

takes.en: Up to 3 weeks by mail from March to September; longer from October to February.
takes.zh: 3 月至 9 月邮寄最长约 3 周；10 月至次年 2 月更久。

label.en: Owner: the company's legal name and Alaska Entity Number
label.zh: 持有人：公司法定名称及阿拉斯加州实体编号

label.en: Business name it operates and advertises under
label.zh: 经营和宣传所用的商号

plain.en: The general license every business working in Alaska needs from the state.
plain.zh: 在阿拉斯加州经营的所有企业都须向州政府申领的一般营业执照。

proof.quote: or another business activity must obtain an Alaska Business License.
proof.en: Any for-profit or non-profit business that engages in a trade, service, profession or other business activity must obtain an Alaska Business License.

form: Alaska Employer Registration Form (Form TREG, Rev. 2/19)

title.zh: 阿拉斯加州雇主登记（失业保险）

agency.en: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development, Employment Security Tax
agency.zh: 阿拉斯加州劳工与劳动力发展厅就业保障税处

how.en: Register online through myAlaska (Employment Security Tax, New Registration), or send the signed Form TREG by fax, email or mail to Employment Security Tax in Juneau. Alaska has no state income tax to withhold.
how.zh: 通过 myAlaska 在线登记（Employment Security Tax 下的 New Registration），或将签字的 TREG 表以传真、电子邮件或邮寄方式发送至朱诺的就业保障税处。阿拉斯加州没有须预扣的州所得税。

feeNote.en: The agency's page doesn't state a fee; it confirms any fee when it takes the filing.
feeNote.zh: 该机构页面未注明费用；如有费用，受理时由其确认。

label.en: Date wages were first paid in the state (MM/DD/YYYY)
label.zh: 在该州首次支付工资的日期（月/日/年）
所有者或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: The account an Alaska employer pays unemployment insurance through, once it has paid anyone in the state.
plain.zh: 阿拉斯加州雇主在该州支付工资后，用于缴纳失业保险的账户。

proof.quote: has employed one or more persons is required by law to register.
proof.en: Any person, firm, corporation or other organization that has employed one or more persons for some portion of a day is required by law to register.

form: Food Establishment Permit Application (DEC Food Safety and Sanitation)

title.zh: 阿拉斯加州食品经营场所许可证

agency.en: Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation, Food Safety and Sanitation Program
agency.zh: 阿拉斯加州环境保护厅食品安全与卫生项目

how.en: Submit DEC's Food Establishment Permit Application (with a plan review application for new construction) before opening; DEC covers restaurants, markets and food processors, including warehousing. In Anchorage, the Anchorage Health Department's food safety program applies instead.
how.zh: 开业前提交环境保护厅的食品经营场所许可申请（新建场所另附图纸审查申请）；该厅负责餐厅、食品商店及食品加工（包括仓储）。在安克雷奇，改由安克雷奇卫生局的食品安全项目负责。

feeNote.en: Set on DEC's permit fee schedule.
feeNote.zh: 按环境保护厅许可收费标准确定。

label.zh: 持照人（业主或经营者）法定名称

label.en: Establishment address, city, ZIP and county
label.zh: 经营场所地址、城市、邮编及县

label.en: Foods handled and how (stored, processed, packaged, sold)
label.zh: 经营的食品及方式（储存、加工、包装、销售）
所有者、合伙人或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: Alaska's permit for a restaurant, food store or food plant.
plain.zh: 阿拉斯加州为餐厅、食品商店或食品加工厂颁发的许可证。

proof.quote: No matter what you are planning on doing you will need to submit a Food Establishment Application.

form: Food establishment permit: food manufacturer or food warehouse (HAR 11-50)

title.en: Hawaii food manufacturer or warehouse permit
title.zh: 夏威夷州食品加工或仓储许可证

agency.en: Hawaii Department of Health, Food Safety Branch
agency.zh: 夏威夷州卫生局食品安全处

how.en: Apply to the Department of Health's Food Safety Branch for the island; a place that stores, manufactures or packages food for wholesale is a food establishment and is inspected and permitted like a restaurant.
how.zh: 向所在岛屿的州卫生局食品安全处申请；储存、加工或包装批发食品的场所属于食品经营场所，与餐厅一样须接受检查并取得许可。

feeNote.en: Set by HAR 11-50-7 by the operation's size and risk category.
feeNote.zh: 按《夏威夷行政规则》11-50-7 依经营规模和风险类别确定。

label.zh: 持照人（业主或经营者）法定名称

label.en: Establishment address, city, ZIP and county
label.zh: 经营场所地址、城市、邮编及县

label.en: Foods handled and how (stored, processed, packaged, sold)
label.zh: 经营的食品及方式（储存、加工、包装、销售）
所有者、合伙人或高管：“姓名、职务”

plain.en: Hawaii's health permit for a food plant or food warehouse.
plain.zh: 夏威夷州为食品加工厂或食品仓库颁发的卫生许可证。

proof.quote: No person may operate a food establishment without a valid permit issued by the director
